name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-reparse-escape-guard
description: Pre-dispatch guard for dsh writes whose path leaves the granted write area through a link. Every write confinement in the harness canonicalizes first and then refuses, which is the right enforcement answer and a poor diagnostic one: `<workspace>/link/out.txt`, where `link` resolves outside, fails containment exactly like `../../out.txt`, so the model cannot tell which component disagreed with the spelling it produced. Mounted on the public tools/pre-execute waterfall, this plugin resolves the written operands of a call the way the kernel will, compares them against the same writableRoots()/canonicalPath() derivation the fence uses, and refuses the call before dispatch with a message naming the apparent path, the resolved path and the responsible link. Reads through an alias are legal everywhere and are left alone; a call asking for wider access is left to the approval flow. Compatible with the dsh 0.1.5, 0.1.6 and 0.1.7 prerelease lines.
